verdict.rationale: Grok has a documented programmatic REST API with a published OpenAPI spec, a quickstart for sending coding prompts to Grok Build, and structured JSON outputs. Together these let automation scripts call it without a UI, and a community user notes Grok Build runs in a terminal. No documentation describes a headless mode, non-interactive CLI flags, or CI integration specifically. missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive CLI mode, CI pipeline integration docs or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), auth/env-var guidance for CI, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Generate text, have conversations, use tools, and build AI-powered applications.
Send a coding prompt to Grok Build (`grok-4.6`) and get a response.
